transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 1880 Loch Katrine Lane?

Yeah, this is me at 1880 Loch Katrine Lane—just me and the two others, we’re all good, no water in the house, and we’re not stuck or anything, but we don’t have a truck or boat or extra seats to help out if needed.
Thanks for confirming your situation and needs. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Just three of us here, all good, no one’s stuck inside or can’t make it to the phone—water’s not even in the house, so we’re all fine and no help needed right now.

Thanks for letting us know you’re all safe and okay. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
Nope, everyone’s good to go—no one’s stuck or needs special help, and no wheelchairs or oxygen here, just three of us chilling fine inside, no water in yet either.
Thanks for checking in, everyone’s fine inside right now. Is there water inside the home right now?
No water inside at all, just us three hanging out fine, no need to worry about flooding in here.
Good to hear you’re all safe and dry inside. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
Nope, no truck, no boat, and we’re all good—no free seats either, just three of us stuck here, but we’re safe and dry, no worries!
Let me read that back: 3 people; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Yeah, that’s right—three of us here, no water in yet, and we’re all good, no one needs to be left alone, and we don’t have any truck or boat or seats to help with anything, but we’re fine.
Thanks for confirming you’re all safe and accounted for. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
